sources.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. ONE original Bargebow operator WALKING passing-A frame. FIRST image is leg articulation guide only: BLUE NEAR leg planted below hips; ORANGE FAR knee bends with far boot lifted behind supporting shin. SECOND image supplies exact identity, camera, hoisted equipment and its dimensions. One woman steel brim helmet gold crest, dark hair, cream/red coat teal scarf sash and leg wraps, brown boots. She carries ONE complete heavy wood/brass crossbow with winch spool, loaded bolt, teal side quiver and THREE attached wooden tripod legs. Both arms support the rear crossbow/handles against torso; near right hand holds side handle below spool, far left arm supports far stock, not dangling. Entire tripod is lifted with its feet just above her boot-ground level; retain exact weapon proportions and all three attached legs. Preserve fixed elevated three-quarter RIGHT-facing camera and upright stable torso. Change the actual human leg joints for specified passing step, robe panels separate naturally, exactly two human legs and three wooden tripod legs, no additional crew. Original painterly game raster matching second reference not diagram colors/lines, no mirror. All body and full mounted bow inside wide margins. Flat vivid GREEN #00ff00 background only, neutral light no green reflections/spill; no floor/shadow/text/effects/scenery.
sources.selection: Select visible raised rear foot; generator did not follow guide's named near/far ownership literally. Actual anatomy and connected gait remain review items.
